title: 沃什讲话定调：通胀目标重回PCE，市场会如何反应？
speaker: Kevin Gordon

segments.en: Kevin, I want to start with you. It felt like listening to Warsh speak. Initially, I was like, oh, this is nothing, but nothing new. But the more I spoke with people afterwards, my mind changed. What was your takeaway initially?
segments.zh: 凯文，我想先请你谈谈。听沃什讲话，一开始我觉得没什么新意。但后来和人们交流后，我改变了看法。你最初的感受是什么？

segments.en: So I think that really this speech was the set of remarks we were looking for in July after that press conference. Essentially, I think right sizes and corrects for what was this ambiguous kind of message coming from the chair after that July decision to keep rates steady.
segments.zh: 我认为这次讲话正是我们在七月新闻发布会后期待的内容。基本上，它修正了七月维持利率不变后主席传递的模糊信号。

segments.en: I think more than cleared the bar for what the consensus was coming into this because there were a lot of questions over whether he was going to even talk about inflation and labor and the dynamics of the economy. So the fact that you did get this more laid out scenario and his economic analysis, I think is really him catching up to what the rest of the committee has been doing.
segments.zh: 我认为这远超市场共识预期，因为此前很多人质疑他是否会谈论通胀、劳动力以及经济动态。事实上，他给出了更详细的展望和经济分析，我认为这让他跟上了委员会其他成员的步伐。

segments.en: What are the drivers? Business investment being a strong one. Our financial conditions restrictive, him not seeing that right now, especially even with weakness and housing and agriculture he made that specific call out, even though you're seeing weakness there. I mean, that's where rate cuts would help. He's not seeing that as a case to be made that the broader economy is under this pressure from Fed policy right now.
segments.zh: 驱动因素是什么？商业活动是重要一环。他认为当前金融条件并非紧缩，尽管地产和农业领域出现疲软，他特别指出了这一点。但降息可能有助于这些领域，他并不认为整体经济正承受美联储政策的压力。

segments.en: So I do think that he certainly checked a lot of boxes in terms of what investors were looking for. And I think probably most importantly, really reaffirmed that commitment to PCE being the target and then 2% being also the inflation target. So the metric and also the rate of change. You know, firmly, I think we're committing to that was was crucial, because especially because in the last meeting. Again, there was a little bit of ambiguity around whether he was going to look at a different set of metrics and not necessarily PCE. Yeah, and I think when you look at those first remarks, and then these remarks, the thing that struck me is the pledge that he would take action, right? He says, you know, if if you don't have confidence, then we've got more work to do. I thought that was significant.
segments.zh: 我认为他确实满足了投资者的许多期待。最重要的是，他重申了以PCE为通胀目标、2%为目标的承诺。这一点至关重要，因为上次会议中，他是否会采用不同指标存在模糊性。而且，他承诺将采取行动，这很关键。
